Title: Aarav and the Family

Cast

1. Aarav - 8 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Anjali - 40 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Aarav: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aarav walks across the courtyard.]

Aarav: "One more time!"

[Aarav runs to Mother.]

Aarav (softly): "Yes, of course."

[Aarav tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Aarav (happily): "I knew it!"

[Aarav climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Aarav: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The snowy hillside - Day

[Aarav stands in the snow. Anjali stands near him.]

Aarav: "What a nice place."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Aarav (softly): "Exactly right."

[Aarav makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Anjali: "I'm ready!"

[Aarav builds a snowman.]

Anjali: "Good job, Aarav!"

[Aarav catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Aarav (excited): "Yes, of course."

[Aarav slides down the snowy slope.]

Anjali: "Oh wow!"

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

[Aarav stands in the kitchen. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "What a nice place."

[Aarav makes tea for everyone.]

Aarav (softly): "One more time!"

[Aarav chops onions for the curry.]

Aarav (excited): "One more time!"

[Aarav washes the dishes after dinner.]

Aarav: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
